data.title: Cabinet approves cheaper fuel prices for 3 months
data.description: The cabinet has approved a three-month reduction in excise taxes on E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel to help farmers, transport operators, and consumers while boosting demand for agricultural products used in biofuel production, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Tuesday.

data.title: Army says trail resort lacks land-use permit
data.description: A trail-running venue and resort in Nakhon Nayok linked to Athip "God" Anantawan, husband of former beauty queen and charity founder Panadda "Bum" Wongphudee, had no military permission to use the land, the army said on Tuesday.

data.title: Censure debate 'unlikely before Dec': PM
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul does not expect the opposition's no-confidence debate to take place before early December, saying ministers have packed schedules in November and cannot postpone official engagements.

data.title: Health officials track risks from suspected waste leak
data.description: The Public Health Ministry's Department of Disease Control opened an emergency operations centre to monitor health risks after the floods caused a probable leakage from an industrial waste landfill in Prachin Buri province.

data.title: Anutin signals lawsuit for MP's 'tea money' post
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Tuesday signalled he could sue People's Party MP Rukchanok Srinork for sharing a Facebook post showing a fake slip for a 7-million-baht "tea money" transfer.

data.title: UN nuclear watchdog chief urges Iran to grant access
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - IAEA chief Rafael Grossi urged Iran during a UN Security Council meeting on Tuesday to grant immediate access to his agency so it can verify the Islamic republic's nuclear materials.

data.title: Syria condemns deadly Jordan strikes as 'unacceptable violation'
data.description: DAMASCUS - Syria condemned on Tuesday deadly strikes on the country's south a day earlier that Jordan said killed more than 20 jihadists as retaliation for a gun attack on a church.

data.title: UK charges two men with security offences in airbase plot
data.description: LONDON - UK anti-terrorism police said on Tuesday that two men have been charged with national security offences after an incident last month at a British airbase used by the United States, linking the scare to Iran.

data.title: EU seeks deportation powers for beefed-up border agency
data.description: BRUSSELS - The European Union wants to give its border agency greater powers, including handling deportations, under plans to strengthen the bloc’s response to irregular migration presented on Tuesday.

data.title: UK man ‘offered drugged wife to strangers online for sex’
data.description: WINCHESTER, England - A British man who drugged and raped his then-wife over 13 years had advertised online for strangers to have sex with her without her consent, a court heard on Tuesday.

data.title: B35 billion seized from Mauerberger network
data.description: Thai authorities have seized and frozen assets worth 35.8 billion baht in their ongoing investigation into an alleged international money-laundering network linked to South African businessman Benjamin Mauerberger and Cambodia-born entrepreneur Yim Leak.

data.title: Minister defends B200m promotion budget for plant expo
data.description: Deputy Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Watcharaphon Khaokham has defended a request for more than 200 million baht in additional publicity funding for the Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026, citing economic and social benefits.

data.title: Thai, Vietnamese media press for copyright protection
data.description: Thai and Vietnamese media organisations are pushing for stronger copyright protection and fairer revenue-sharing from global technology platforms such as Google and Meta as digital trends erode news publishers’ traffic and income.

data.title: Greenhouse gas levels ‘hit record highs in 2025’
data.description: GENEVA - Greenhouse gas concentrations in the atmosphere rose to record highs in 2025, locking in climate impacts that will persist for centuries to come, the United Nations said on Tuesday.

data.title: Kane says Ballon d’Or win ‘feels like a dream’
data.description: LONDON - Harry Kane said Tuesday that his Ballon d’Or triumph “feels like a dream” as tributes poured in for the first English winner of the award in a generation.

data.title: Defence in Move Forward ethics case to open on Nov 3
data.description: The Supreme Court will begin hearing testimony on Nov 3 from defence witnesses in the ethics case brought against 44 former Move Forward Party MPs.

data.title: Swedish ‘cyber fraudster’ caught on Samui
data.description: SURAT THANI - Thai immigration police have arrested a Swedish national wanted by authorities in his home country after he was found hiding on Koh Samui.

data.title: Norwegian, Finnish leaders hold ‘frank’ talks with Putin
data.description: HELSINKI - The Finnish president and Norwegian prime minister held a “frank and substantive” discussion with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Tuesday about efforts to end the war in Ukraine, the Nordic leaders said.

data.title: Border troops seize millions of meth pills after armed clash
data.description: Army troops seized about four million methamphetamine pills following a skirmish with smugglers near the Myanmar border in Mae Sai district of Chiang Rai province.

data.title: Dutch broadcaster pulls out of Eurovision over Israel 'sensitivities'
data.description: THE HAGUE - The Netherlands will not participate in next year's Eurovision Song Contest, its public broadcaster NPO said on Tuesday, citing "sensitivities" over Israel's participation.

data.title: Celebrating 30 Years of Pokémon
data.description: Bangkok, 26 October 2026 - The Pokémon Company (headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo; CEO Tsunekazu Ishihara) today announced a series of special initiatives planned for Thailand in celebration of the Pokémon 30th Anniversary at a press conference held at centralwOrld in Bangkok. The announcement highlighted a range of upcoming events and experiences designed to bring the world of Pokémon closer to fans across Thailand.
